params.name: includeLogs
params.description: If true, you get a "logs" array in the results

params.name: userSessionId
params.description: Filters by this user ID (aka "participant ID"). Required if `mtgSessionId` is not present in the request

params.name: mtgSessionId
params.description: Filters by this Session ID. Required if `userSessionId` is not present in the request

params.name: logLevel
params.description: Filters by the given log level name

params.name: startTime
params.description: A JS timestamp (ms since epoch in UTC)

params.name: endTime
params.description: A JS timestamp (ms since epoch), defaults to the current time

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of logs and/or metrics returned

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip before returning results

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Given the log ID, will return all records after that ID. See [pagination docs](../../rest-api#pagination)

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Given the log ID, will return all records before that ID. See [pagination docs](../../rest-api#pagination)

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of logs and/or metrics returned

params.name: source
params.description: The source of the given logs, either `"api"` or `"webhook"`

params.name: url
params.description: Either the webhook server URL, or the API endpoint that was logged
